clock: Local monotonic milliseconds from voice start; prewarm events occur before that reset and are not comparable.

network.rtp_jitter_units: RTP timestamp ticks, not milliseconds; audio clock is 48000 Hz.

limitations: Notification arrival times bound observed stages; they do not expose server queue time, pure inference time, DNS or search provider internal timing.
First software PCM is not measured acoustic playback.
Search completion proves a tool event, not forecast correctness. No query, URL, transcript or credentials are recorded.
A single sample is not a performance distribution.

Microphone source EOF was 3695 ms, while the last nonquiet outgoing frame was 4694 ms: startup buffering contributes to the input-to-backend interval. Do not label the whole interval VAD delay. Maximum queue 95 frames occurred during startup, not sustained backlog.

observed_error_signals.interpretation: Counts are observed signals, not an assertion that every internal provider failure is exposed.

error_capture_limit: This historical run predates explicit thread/realtime/error capture. Zero counts describe only recorded signals; future traces include that notification.
